title: constant-time bearer token comparison in both admin servers
description:
## Decision
Both crates/transit/src/admin.rs and crates/reader/src/admin.rs use subtle::ConstantTimeEq for bearer token comparison. This prevents timing oracle attacks that could leak the token character-by-character via response time measurement. The comparison is implemented correctly: both sides are converted to bytes and compared with ct_eq before the bool conversion.
